editorial:
Looking for a quick way to get into the holiday spirit? You should check out these four short stories featuring everyone's favorite yellow troublemakers. Instead of one long plot, you get bite-sized adventures where the Minions try to celebrate the season, but as usual, things go totally wrong. The vibe is pure chaos and laughter, making it the perfect choice for a rainy afternoon or a family gathering where you just want something light and silly to watch. It captures that classic slapstick energy that makes these characters so lovable.

What really works here is the pacing, as the short format keeps the energy high without any boring parts. You will love the funny cameos and the bright, colorful animation that looks amazing on screen. While it is not a deep story, it delivers exactly what you expect from a comedy special. If you have a 4K TV, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the vivid colors pop. Or, if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for future movie nights with the kids.
endingExplained: The special wraps up after several failed attempts at holiday cheer, ending with a big, messy celebration. After causing a lot of destruction in their quest for the perfect gift and party, the Minions finally realize that being together is what actually matters. The final scene shows them all piling together in a huge, goofy group hug, proving that their friendship is stronger than any holiday disaster they created along the way.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slapstick humor and cute characters.
